games.name: Age of Me - The Chosen One
Desktop Mate STREET FIGHTER 6 CHUN-LI DLC
Desktop Mate STREET FIGHTER 6 RYU DLC
Fakin' It XL
games.summary:
Fakin’ It XL is all about lying your way to victory. Each round presents a simple prompt to all players on their phone or device like “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Everyone is on the same page – except for the faker, who must act as if they’ve received the same prompt as everyone else. Blend in by bluffing, grilling and deflecting through three rounds of interrogation to rack up points. Who knew that casting suspicion on others could be so personally rewarding?

Fakin’ It XL Features:

    New Hijinks-fueling Questions: Emojinal Damage and Thumb Luck mix things up alongside classic Fakin’ It question types for maximum friend-deceiving scheming:
    Emojional Damage challenges players to phrase their answers in the form of an emoji, such as “the emoji for a perfect gift for your boss” while the Faker only has a general category, like “the emoji of an object.” Now, can the Faker explain why giving their boss a shoe is a great idea.
    Thumb Luck asks everyone to weigh in with a quick thumbs up or down on three opinion-worthy items in a row, like “Working from Home” or “Dogs in Costumes”. The Faker has to choose without knowing the subject, though—can they justify their support for “Singing Along With Musicals”?
    Enhanced Remote Play: New options let your avatar take action for you, so the game works just as well on a video call as it does in your living room.
    XL-sized Parties: Now up to eight players can join the same game, making for the rowdiest Fakin’ It sessions ever. Good thing there’s plenty of new avatar choices for everyone to choose from, too.

games.name: Love in Summer – 2K HD Video Resource Pack
Love in Summer – 4K Ultra HD Video Resource Pack
10 Second Mixtape
games.summary:
10 Second Mixtape is a casual game about teaming up to make simple songs with other real people from all over the world. Every track in the game is player-generated; absolutely nothing is prewritten. Don't worry if you're not musically inclined! There are no winners here - it's all about having fun and making silly sounds.

You start in The Venue, your favorite spot to hang out and watch bands! The bands playing are all other players' creations. Your ratings will affect how often that band is booked for shows in everyone else's games. When you start making a song, you'll be given a random instrument and bandmate, and you'll record a 10 second track.

From there, it's time to add more layers! You can pick from demo tapes sent in by other potential band members to add to your track. Finally, it's time to take this show on the road! Watch your band perform the full song live in front of their new fans. Your new 10-second song will go into the infinite playlist of bands that play at The Venue.

games.name: 687 Days on Mars - First Steps
games.summary: Take your first steps on Mars and face the challenge of surviving alone on the Red Planet. Build your first shelter, secure vital resources, grow food, research new technologies, and explore the hostile Martian landscape. Your survival starts here.

games.name: A Pet Shop After Dark
games.summary:
A PET SHOP AFTER DARK is a horror point-and-click visual novel where you've taken on an odd job at a little pet shop. The owner tells you the job is easy - all you have to do is water the plants, feed the pets, and stay the night. 

There's just one thing - do NOT, under any circumstances, turn off the lights.

games.name: Adorable Adventures
games.summary:
Adorable Adventures is a relaxing third-person exploration game where you play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn to use his nose to reunite with his family, who were separated after a forest fire.

Across rolling meadows, sun-dappled forest paths, deep caves, and rocky highlands, identify scents and follow trails to learn more about the world around you. Search for your brothers and sisters, uncover secrets, and expand your library of smells against the backdrop of a gentle and heart-warming story.

games.name: ALL EYES ON ME
games.summary: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. Thousands of eyes hunt you in this bullet heaven roguelite. Their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play local co-op or online conquests.

games.name: Animal Cubes: Tidy Up Dreams
games.summary: A cozy organization simulator in a dream: sort 6344 cubic animals, 120 unique species onto the right shelves. Turn a chaotic dream into a perfectly organized collection.

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Barbie Rewind
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games in this cozy and creative game. Barbie Rewind pulls you back in time through iconic eras of Barbie with stunning pixel art and retro style. Your bestie, Barbie, invites you into her world and entrusts you to update her DreamHouse with your unique style, using items from 65+ years of Barbie history.

Choose from three retro DreamHouse designs for your exterior facade, walls, and floors. You can even mix-and-match them from room to room. Style each room with a fabulous collection of furniture, decor, and accessories, inspired by real Barbie playsets throughout the decades. From a classic pink vanity to a ‘90s inflatable chair, make the DreamHouse unique to your style and creativity.

Barbie has also left you her game collection of 16 Barbie video games from 1991 through 2007. Titles include Barbie Pet Rescue, Barbie Horse Adventures: Blue Ribbon Race, and the never-before-released game, Barbie: Vacation Adventure. Play through the collection to complete additional quests and unlock more items.

games.name: BATTLE: PARTS & POWER
games.summary: Design robot blueprints, equip new parts, and run automated factories in a 2D idle auto battler. Build and upgrade production lines during battle, defend your headquarters, and refine each loadout to overcome escalating enemy waves.

games.name: Bean in a Ball Pit
games.summary: One bean. A ridiculous number of balls. Dig into a colorful physics playground, turn cleared balls into cash, and build a wonderfully excessive cleanup operation with vacuums, conveyors, cannons, and bots. Somewhere underneath it all, your bean is waiting.

games.name: Big Scoop: Trash Cleaning Simulator
games.summary: The ocean is drowning in plastic. Steer your boat, scoop up trash, sell at port and grow from a 3.6 m Skiff to a 70 m Megascoop with over 40 boats in your fleet. Play solo or in a crew of up to 4 online, and clean it all up until the sea turns turquoise again.

games.name: Bings
games.summary: Dive into a nostalgic notebook world in Bings. Navigate challenging physics-based puzzles and overcome obstacles in this sketch-art style precision game. Test your reflexes, time your moves perfectly, and conquer every doodle-filled level.

games.name: BLIP (Poquinette)
games.summary: Welcome to B.L.I.P., a semi-idle incremental game about a tiny lab with unreasonable ambitions! Build machines, recruit Scientists, and make an absurd number of Blips.

games.name: Boing Fight
games.summary: A physics party brawler for 2–4 players on one screen. Grab weapons falling from the sky, bounce around 150 arenas full of saws, portals and trapdoors, and be the last Boing standing. Bots fill empty seats; play locally, on LAN or online.

games.name: Boom and Bust: A Minister's Dilemma
games.summary: Lead Korzarkia through economic crisis from the minister's desk. Set budgets, taxes and monetary policy, confront banking failures and political pressure, and face the consequences of your decisions in a deeply connected economic simulation.

games.name: Boxing - MotionPlay
games.summary:
Step into the ring and become the boxer and keep fit.

Using the free MotionPlay App on a compatible smartphone, your phone’s camera tracks your movements and turns them into action in the game. Raise your guard, throw jabs and hooks, and block incoming attacks as you battle it out in the ring.

Take on 7 different fighters, each with their own strengths and fighting style. Every match is fought across 3 intense rounds - land the knockout blow before your opponent knocks you out!
Boxing MotionPlay creates an immersive experience where your movements control the action, making you feel physically part of the game rather than simply controlling a character. Punch, block and react as the fight unfolds around you.

It’s also a fun way to get active. Boxing MotionPlay can turn a gaming session into an energetic, fitness-style workout while you play.

Powered by patent-pending MotionPlay body-tracking technology, setup is quick and simple, with no additional camera accessory or wearable controller required.

games.name: Brain Party
games.summary: Brain Party is a multiplayer puzzle party game. Compete online with other players for first place by total score. Unlock higher difficulties and beat your personal bests in solo challenges, or take on fresh daily challenges and climb the global leaderboard.

games.name: Build Christmas
games.summary: Build a cozy 3D North Pole village. Connect candy, wooden toy, and plush production chains, house your elves, decorate snowy streets, and load presents aboard the courier sleighs before Christmas Eve. Grow your village and uncover Santa's mystery.

games.name: Bullet Glory
games.summary: A neon arena score-attack shooter. Clear bullet storms, unlock 12 ships with distinct specials, team up in local co-op, and study leaderboard replays to push your score higher.

games.name: Bumperhead
games.summary:
Bumperhead is a 3D ragdoll physics crash comedy. You are the newest test subject for the Ministry of Questionable Safety, and your job is simple: climb into a ridiculous vehicle, speed down tracks full of ramps and hazards, and crash as spectacularly as possible.

Your rider is a floppy ragdoll with real physics. Every bump throws them from the seat, sends them tumbling and bending in all the wrong directions, while the vehicle falls apart piece by piece around them. It is all slapstick, with no blood, just bruises, bandages and very bad decisions.

games.name: Can You Beat The AI God?
games.summary: Can You Beat The AI God? is an action-packed bullet-heaven roguelite. Survive endless swarms of robotic enemies, unlock devastating synergies, and upgrade your abilities. Test your limits and see if you can defeat the ultimate AI God!

games.name: Cards: Tidy Up!
games.summary: Tidy up a room full of scattered playing cards into neatly completed decks. Sort by theme, suit, and rank in this relaxing first-person tidy-up game. Earn upgrades, discover helpful machines for automation, and find your own satisfying way to clear the table.

games.name: Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Boys
games.summary:
Cats have gotten angry about so many memes… now they’ve rebelled against the internet.

The memes were funny… until the cats fought back.

In Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Boys, a rebellion begins.
Not against people… but against the digital world that turned them into icons.

Step into a chaotic clash where charm turns dangerous, and nothing online is safe anymore.

games.name: Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Girls
games.summary:
Cats ruled the internet… now they’re taking it back.

The memes were funny… until the cats fought back.

In Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Girls, a rebellion begins.
Not against people… but against the digital world that made them a joke.

Step into a chaotic clash where cute turns dangerous, and nothing online is safe anymore.

♠ BATTLE THE INTERNET WITH CARDS
Face the internet itself in strategic card battles.
Build your deck, unleash powerful combos, and prove that cats rule the web.

♣ DATE CATGIRLS AND POWER UP
Behind every card, there’s a girl.
Win their trust, go on dates, and unlock new abilities that transform your strategy.

♥ FROM CUTE TO CHAOS
What starts as adorable quickly turns unpredictable.
The deeper you go, the weirder it gets.
This is not just a game… it’s a war.

♦ BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE DECK
Collect, upgrade, and combine cards to create unstoppable strategies.
Every decision matters—both in battle and in love.

games.name: Cheesty
games.summary: Step into the paws of a bold lab rat on a desperate escape to freedom. Leave your scars and past behind using your wits: manipulate the environment, use makeshift tools, and sniff out the right path to the exit in this chaotic stealth, puzzle, and platforming adventure.

games.name: ChickenPlaguePolice
games.summary: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

games.name: ChromaFlow
games.summary: Build a factory powered by color. Extract red, green, and blue, route them through conveyor networks, and mix them into an expanding spectrum. Fulfil requests for the Chroma Core, unlock new technology, and optimize every production line.

games.name: Combat Kart
games.summary: A casual yet thrilling kart racing game. Experience top-notch drifting, exhilarating nitro boosts, adorable characters, and unique combat skills. Supports local multiplayer for up to four players and Remote Play Together!Get the ultimate experience on the Steam Deck as well.

games.name: Cupiclaw
games.summary:
Oh, no! Morris lost his engagement ring and is too broke to buy another! Luckily, beautiful rings can be won on the top floor of the arcade.

Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder.

Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines... and claw back Morris’ relationship!

games.name: Deadzone Cleanup Crew
games.summary: Scavenge scrap, upgrade your base, hire survivors, and clear zombie-infested zones in Deadzone Cleanup Crew, a click-to-clear apocalypse incremental game with escalating waves, bosses, and big satisfying numbers!

games.name: Delve Survivors
games.summary: A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!

games.name: DemonBlade Pixel: Hyakki Senkou
games.summary: A 2D bullet-hell action roguelite steeped in yokai fantasy. Collect demon blades with 8 playable fighters, cut through 35 story chapters, challenge Kimon Renrou and boss trials, and play solo or in up to 3-player online co-op.

games.name: Disaster Scenario
games.summary: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear a gauntlet of absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the raucous pitch-and-bet party game — or go solo and 1v1 for a sharper, strategic run. First to the finish wins.

games.name: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft
games.summary: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft is a toilet-humour clicker set in a bubbling sewer laboratory. Click to make dookie, build ten ridiculous factories from the Whoopie Cushion to the Methane Volcano, snatch random power-ups and grow your stinkiest empire yet.

games.name: E.G.O. Software Suite
games.summary: Superego Inc. presents E.G.O. Software Suite: personal applications built on state-of-the-art inter-universal technology powered by the SUPERᵁ™ Framework. Browse the Universe Wide Web with our flagship Tempest browser or communicate with people across worlds.

games.name: Emoji Killer - Space Rampage
games.summary:
Shoot, dodge, kill, upgrade, unlock... do not let a single emoji escape!

You awake in a mysterious casino where evil poker emojis have awakened — and they’re not happy to see you.

This rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into a wild casino environments, fast-paced combat against gambling addicted emojis wearing funny hats and wielding powers.

Before each run, customize your experience with crazy modifiers: make enemies bounce, wear funny hats, or unleash maximum casino power for maximum challenge.

Armed with just a pistol, you’ll face wave after wave of emojis that rush, leap, explode, or even summon others to fight. Defeat them to collect glowing orbs, level up, and unlock upgrades or powerful new weapons. Each decision shapes your survival — will you go for raw power, faster reloads, or explosive mayhem?

Survive long enough, and you’ll uncover new arenas, more upgrades, and deeper chaos for your next run.

Can you conquer the casino before the emojis claim you?

games.name: Endless Reach
games.summary: Fly a smuggler's run into a swarm of thousands. Every orb you catch is XP and cargo. Stay and the heat brings turrets, then a boss. Call the jump, hold the zone while the drive charges, and bank it all. Die, and you keep a fraction. The music follows how well you fly.

games.name: Everybody Hates You in TOKYO Soundtrack
Evidence Vault
games.summary: Your first night shift in a police evidence archive nobody has filed in years. Pick up loose papers, photos and tapes, uncover hidden case numbers with the right tool, then press, stamp, box and shelve each case. No clock, no quota, no way to fail.

games.name: Fish Battle Champion
games.summary: Catch fishes and items from the sea while the sun is up, trade & buy equipment during the evening and attend Fish Autobattle tournament during the night! Survive to the finals and beyond to become the Fish Battle Champion!

games.name: Fish Market Tidy Up!
games.summary: Fish Market Tidy Up is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort different species of fish scattered throughout a fish store. Return every fish to its proper place, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.

games.name: FLOWFALL Inertia
games.summary: Fall through fourteen worlds, from deep space to the inside of a living cell. Morph your glowing shape to slip through gates timed to an original soundtrack, then race up to three friends online. Chill when you want it, dazzling when you've mastered it.

games.name: Fluffy Friends - Counting Farm
games.summary:
15 preschool mini games with adorable farm animals!

Fluffy Friends is the perfect first learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 carefully crafted mini games set in a breathtaking forest full of rivers, colourful trees and adorable zoo animals, this is early education at its most enchanting.
Children count exotic animals, compare groups, train their memory, find the biggest and smallest creatures, and tap numbers in the correct order — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds designed to keep little ones engaged and motivated.
Whether played together or explored independently, Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool makes every learning moment feel like a magical adventure in the forest.

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
Counting and number recognition Comparing groups and sizes Memory and observation skills Logical ordering and sequencing Species recognition and categorisation

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE
Did you see this animal? Which animal did you not see? Which group has the most animals? Count all animals and species Find the biggest and smallest animal Remember the order and tap correctly Memory and much more!

games.name: For My Kingdom
games.summary: A medieval decision making and kingdom management game. Swipe the cards your advisors bring you to keep your treasury, army, granary and the church's support in balance, repel the armies attacking your borders and pass the throne to your heir to grow your dynasty across the generations.

games.name: Franchise Hockey Manager 13
games.summary: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2026-27 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

games.name: Frontier Tale
games.summary: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: Gestalt Journey
games.summary: An incremental game (a clicker) where everything keeps growing while you decide where to put your resources. And a history lesson: as you play, you learn the real story of Gestalt therapy — its people, theories, books and organisations.

games.name: Gnat Pack
games.summary: A short incremental game about feeding a swarm of hungry gnats. Guide your bugs to the fruit, and unlock upgrades to grow your pack of buzzing buddies one bite at a time.

games.name: Gods Formation
games.summary: Build a team of three mythic heroes in an inventory-management auto-battler. Arrange weapons and beasts, craft powerful gear, and combine elemental and adjacency effects. Refine your formation between rounds and face saved player teams in asynchronous battles.

games.name: Grazed - Incremental Arcade
games.summary: The closer you get, the stronger you get. Grazed is an incremental arcade game where to kill you have to get in range of dying. Push your kill combo high enough to ignite absurd powers and chase the highest score. Every run earns upgrades, so you always come back deadlier.

games.name: Hammered Heroes
games.summary: Lead a drunken band of adventurers down the deepest dungeon in the realm. Pick the party, choose the path, and watch them carve through frost, fire, and worse. Fall, pour another, and descend again — stronger each time. Raise a tankard. Raise a warhammer.

games.name: Harold Halibut
games.summary:
Harold Halibut is a handmade narrative game about friendship, and life on a city-sized spaceship submerged in an alien ocean. 

It's been 250 years since your home - an ark-like spaceship - fled an Earth on the verge of cold war to find a habitable planet on which to preserve the human race. 
You are Harold, a young lab assistant for the ship's lead scientist, Jeanne Mareaux. While most of the ship's inhabitants have reconciled themselves to a life lived aboard the sunken ship, Mareaux still works tirelessly to find a way for the ship to leave the planet and find a new, dryer home. 

But of course the weird, wonderful and diverse people of the Fedora keep Harold busy too. Until one fateful encounter plunges Harold into a new world that nobody could have guessed existed - and one that may hold the key to Mareaux's re-launch plans. 

Join Harold as he explores a vibrant retro-future world, talks (with full voice acting) to its inhabitants, and occasionally goes hands on by sticking screwdrivers in things, operating complex machinery, and more in his quest to find the true meaning of 'home'.

games.name: Hazard Levels
games.summary:
The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

Hazard Levels is a brand new co-op survival horror from the team behind Sker Ritual.

games.name: Heartrift
games.summary: Low scores. High stakes. HEARTRIFT is a single-player tactical card roguelike. Reveal cards, replace high values and clear matching columns. Develop four colour paths, combine relics and choose your route through a fractured world.

games.name: Historical War: The Animation
games.summary: Historical War: The Animation is a library of classic-war animated reconstructions. Watch famous campaigns from Alexander to the Gulf War on a scrubbable timeline—play, pause, replay. Each film is about five minutes. Napoleon is the dividing line: earlier wars are Ancient, later wars are Modern.

games.name: Hit or Die
games.summary: Four players, one table, the number 21. Draw, stand, or bluff. Whoever ends the round furthest from the target gets the mallet, the anvil, or the revolver. Cheat with scissors, dice and a syringe you keep in your own drawer. Chips are your health. Last one breathing wins.

games.name: I Was Reincarnated with the [Idle] Skill, and Now I Do Nothing
Idle of the Dead — Scavenger's Backpack
Idle of the Dead: Radio Host
Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys
Imp Pact
games.summary: An incremental where an ageing man who cannot read makes his mark on an imp's contract, puts the imps to work on the rats in his cellar, and is billed for the trial period. Keep the interest current, in blood, every forty-five seconds, or he takes imps back, and is apologetic about it.

games.name: Impossible Road
games.summary: Play as a King armed with a Book-Bazooka! Blast enemies with flying literature to increase your Wisdom score. Answer trivia questions correctly to upgrade your health and speed in this fast-paced, educational action-shooter.

games.name: Just Farm
games.summary: Farming games can be complicated. This one isn’t. No empire to manage, no endless chores, no agricultural career waiting for you. Just relax, get in the tractor, and farm.

games.name: Kaiju Boys: Trap Giant Monsters & Fall in Love
games.summary:
Fight him. Trap him. Date him. Hold on... you're going out with the thing that ate the harbor?!

Giant monsters are tearing the city apart, and you're the only one crazy enough to try catching them.

Plot twist: every kaiju you trap turns into a ridiculously hot anime boy who still has a habit of knocking over buildings.

Beat them in turn-based battles, trap them before they flatten another block, and watch the transformation happen. Then ask them out and hope he doesn't breathe fire on the waiter.

A few of the monsters waiting for you:

● A lava-blooded lizard turned hothead hunk who gets jealous enough to melt the pavement.

● A giant moth guy who can't resist a bright light, or a cute smile.

● A deep-sea titan with a cold stare, broad shoulders, and a soft spot he swears he doesn't have.

games.name: Kaiju Girls: Trap Giant Monsters & Fall in Love
games.summary:
Beat the kaiju. Trap the kaiju. Date the kaiju. Wait... the giant lizard is your girlfriend now?!

Giant monsters are flattening the city, and you're the only one with a trap big enough to stop them. The twist? Every kaiju you catch turns into a gorgeous anime girl who still remembers stomping on skyscrapers.

Fight them in turn-based battles, trap them before they wreck another block, and watch them transform. Then take them on dates and try not to get stepped on.

Meet a few of your catches:

♡ A fire-breathing reptile turned hot-headed beauty who melts down if you show up late.

♡ A giant moth girl drawn to every bright light in the city, including you.

♡ A deep-sea titan with an icy stare and a surprisingly soft side.

Other guys save the city. You get to date the things trying to destroy it. Ready?

games.name: King Dies Rich
games.summary: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

games.name: KNURLWORM
games.summary: Knurlworm is a short character-driven game where every visual asset is made from real woodcut stamps pressed onto real paper. Watch a lone Carver's story unfold print by print as he searches for a mythical worm said to be able to change a person's fate. The KNURLWORM.

games.name: La Muraille 1806
games.summary: A Napoleonic-era Roguelite Tower Defense. Lead the defense of the Wall against the hordes of the apocalypse. Command the united armies of Europe, deploy living lines of defense, map out range cards, and halt tens of thousands of enemies. Ready! Present! Fire! Commander, win humanity one more dawn.

games.name: Lanternborn
games.summary: ▎ The city of Caldera froze one minute before midnight, and the Hollows came out of the dark. Carry the last light through ever-changing streets, light the lamps, break the Bells and decide how the longest night ends. A dark-fantasy action roguelite with a story.

games.name: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
LITTLE KNIGHT: HOMECOMING
games.summary: Return home as a little knight, rescue your neighbors and rebuild your raided village. A storybook 2D action game where combos, charged strikes, rolls and parries carry you through 16 boss fights.

games.name: Loadpath
games.summary: LOADPATH is a physics-driven demolition game about finding the supports that matter. Cut through industrial structures, trigger massive collapses, recover Salvage, upgrade your demolition rig and descend deeper through seven increasingly dangerous sites.

games.name: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz
games.summary: The Bridge That Must Not Be Named became the main DVIZHUHA. Go online, one on one: take the wheel of the tanker that survived and deliver the fuel, or pilot the FPV drone and make sure IT never arrives. And it's all in PS1 style. Weather favors the operator, smoke and a jammer favor the driver.

games.name: MANBOU / VOYAGE
games.summary: Guide a cute, drifting sunfish through an underwater cave in this 2D side-scrolling action game. Dodge rocks, rubbish, shells, anemones, fish and charging orcas. Ride powerful currents, beat your best distance, and retry instantly when one collision ends your run.

games.name: Marble Saga - The Curse of the Sun Temple
games.summary:
A terrible drought plagues the Valley of Amara, and legend has it that only the scattered fire of the ancient Temple of the Sun can put an end to it. As the daughter of the temple’s guardian, Amara descends into its cursed depths to gather the fragmented sun—chamber by chamber—convinced that she is the heroine foretold by an ancient prophecy.

*Marble Saga: The Curse of the Temple of the Sun* is a narrative-driven take on the classic marble-shooting game. A chain of colored marbles winds along a twisting path toward the fiery heart of the temple. From an ancient, sundial-shaped launcher at the center of the chamber, aim and fire your own marbles; match three or more of the same color to break the chain and set it back. Power-ups add excitement to every session: explosive blasts, precision darts, a rainbow marble that connects with any color, a time-freeze ability, and a last-second reversal that pushes the chain back before it reaches the end. Complete the course to win, save your score, and uncover the rest of the story.

This is a complete, standalone adventure within the *Marble Saga* series, chronicling Amara’s journey across 150 hand-crafted levels. Each level features a unique environment with its own winding layout, a distinct aesthetic, and brand-new surprises. As you progress, the narrative deepens: what begins as a simple quest to rekindle the sun evolves into a tale that reveals the true heroes—and villains—behind the legend.

games.name: Mask Splitters
games.summary: Play as a powerful ninja archer capable of teleporting to your arrows. Outplay and outsmart your friends in this frantic arena party game and become the ultimate Mask Splitter!

games.name: Memento Resonance
games.summary: Forge a Resonance with enemy monsters and welcome them into your party. Equip their skills with relics to shape your own battle style, then climb an ever-changing tower as you follow the trail of lost memories in this monster-collecting roguelite turn-based strategy game.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.summary:
From the creative minds behind Persona 3, 4, and 5 comes Metaphor: ReFantazio, a unique fantasy world, where your protagonist will journey alongside his fairy companion, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince. Control your destiny, face your fears and awaken magical "Archetype" powers that lie dormant in your heart. By awakening to an “Archetype,” you will unlock the power to channel and combine the abilities of unique job classes. games.name: TsundereSQL
games.summary: An SQL course that likes you back.TsundereSQL is an anime visual novel built around a complete SQL course. Write real DuckDB queries, pass hidden tests, and earn story scenes with three instructors who slowly warm up as your skill grows.Every SQL exercise runs against DuckDB. Start with your first SELECT and climb through 224 problems across 14 modules toward production-shaped analytics. Real rows come back, hidden tests decide whether the answer holds, and the story advances when your query holds.What you actually learnThe course contains 224 authored problems across 14 modules. 220 are SQL exercises that run and grade against seeded DuckDB datasets. Four are open-ended analyst-judgment cases with a local fallback, so the curriculum does not depend on live AI.SQL Foundations and Aggregation & GROUP BY, from your first SELECT through trustworthy totals and rates.Joins & Set Operations, including left, right, inner, and anti joins on real tables.Subqueries & CTEs for turning a hard question into readable steps.Window Functions, ranking, QUALIFY, frames, gaps and islands, and sessionization.Product & Growth Analytics, including retention, cohorts, funnels, and experiment-shaped questions.Advanced SQL, recursion, JSON, reshaping, data at scale, and data modeling.Working With Production Data, where dates, NULLs, casts, messy JSON, and inconsistent records matter.Thinking Like a Senior Analyst, the Growth Desk, and the Interview Gauntlet for messy real-world reasoning.If you already write SQL, start at the module that hurts. If you are starting from zero, start at the top and let the difficulty climb with you.The castThree instructors run the course. Tsumugi is demanding, Aimi is patient, and Nora is precise to a fault. Their authored routes and scenes are earned through the work. Romance is optional; the curriculum is not.What this is / what this isn'tWhat it is: a SQL course wrapped in a character-driven story for people who learn better when practice has stakes. Each instructor has a fixed, developer-directed route with its own scenes and ending.What it isn't: it is not a branching-choice simulator where every decision reroutes the plot. The routes are authored and fixed. It is not a reference manual or a multiple-choice quiz: you write the queries, and the game checks them.Runs on DuckDB, in a real editorThe workspace includes a schema browser, query editor, result grid, and a grader that compares results against hidden test data. Passing means your query produces the correct result, not merely that it matches a reference string.Content notesThe game includes optional romance storylines and optional suggestive anime artwork (including swimwear or other revealing, non-nude outfits). Before anything else renders on first launch, a content screen requires an affirmative adult confirmation to continue with suggestive artwork or offers a one-click route that disables it. Suggestive artwork is otherwise on by default after confirmation and can be disabled later in Settings. Romance is enabled by default and can be disabled separately. There is no nudity and no explicit sexual content.

About This Game
Immersed in the turbulent "Tohoku" underworld epicof the 1980s, "Northeast Past" is a real-life interactivevideo game that combines hardcore underworldsurvival rules with multi-branching narratives, takingyou to experience the underworld and get involved inthe bloody fate of gang disputes.

A Star-Studded Team for an Authentic Adaptation

Di Huangjin, a renowned interactive movie game producer, oversees the entire gameplay experience from concept to release. The original star cast of the IP also returns for this adaptation. While preserving the IP’s iconic essence, we’ve crafted a fresh take on the story, delivering cinematic live-action interactive gameplay that captures the unadulterated spirit of the Northeast underworld and a one-of-a-kind brand of Eastern heroic fervor.

An Iconic IP – Live the Underworld Legend Yourself
The original novel has sold over 40 million copies, and its live-action adaptation is a Douban classic with an 8.8/10 rating! This time, you’re no longer a bystander to the legend—you forge and write your own 20 years of fiery heroism. Step into the Northeast underworld of the 80s and 90s, and make pivotal choices that could either ignite a blazing legacy or lead to total ruin, amid the fire and frost of a transformative era.

Your Choices Shape the Underworld

Stand by your brothers through thick and thin without hesitation, or swallow your pride and endure humiliation just to survive—every decision unlocks a radically different story branch. Will you become a legendary underworld lord? Or will your fiery life burn out too soon, a tragic ballad cut short? Unlock a host of epic, high-stakes endings as you carve your path.

Immersive Era, Meticulous Detail
With top-tier artistic craftsmanship, the game recreates an era where passion and courage ran through every street. From rusted old factory districts to neon-drenched nightclubs, every scene is steeped in the raw, unfiltered energy of 1980s and 90s Northeast China.

Dynamic Relationships, a Vivid Cast of Characters
Every encounter with the classic characters from the live-action series is a collision of fates, forging unbreakable bonds of brotherhood and heroism. The game’s Archive System delves deep into every character’s backstory, breathing life and humanity into them. Uncover hidden character arcs rife with loyalty, betrayal, and unspoken friendship—each one a new layer to the underworld’s rich tapestry.

games.name: Ex-Master, Zombie
games.summary: Rise from the grave and reclaim what was lost. Explore a Metroidvania world, piece yourself back together, and unleash the true power of the Ex-Master. Death is not the end.

games.name: Leaf Blower Co.
games.summary:
Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

Play through the full story of Leaf Blower Co., clear away clutter and bring back a world of peace and tranquillity. And of course, no-one expects you to do all of this for free! Spend your hard-earned cash on new gear, upgrades, and even new styles. It’s important to have the right tool for the job, and if you don’t do it, who else is gonna skin your bin?

games.name: Mercenary Corps
games.summary: Play as Raptor, an experienced mercenary hired to dismantle a network of arms smugglers and terrorists. Infiltrate outposts, eliminate key targets and sabotage enemy facilities.Experience the full campaign solo or in co-op, then enter competitive PvP. Unlock weapons for PvP through a detailed progression system and track your performance with online statistics.- Full campaign playable solo or in co-op.- PvP combat across 9 maps and 2 game modes.- 16 unlockable weapons.- Detailed progression system.- Online player statistics.- Dedicated server support.

games.name: Mr Sticky's Ragdoll Launch
games.summary:
Help Mr. Sticky make his way through challenging physics-based levels filled with ropes, moving platforms, lasers, traps and deadly obstacles. Use the environment and your timing to swing, bounce and launch Mr. Sticky towards the finish.

Every level brings a new challenge, with clever obstacles and physics-based mechanics that will test your timing and precision. Keep an eye on the timer and try to complete each level as quickly as possible without losing control.

Collect all the stars and beat the clock to earn a 3-star rating! Can you conquer every level, set your fastest times and become a true ragdoll master?


Features:
* 32 levels
* Fun physics ragdoll mechanics
* Different traps to avoid
* Collect all 5 stars
* Easy to play hard to master

games.name: PAWHOLD: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game
QUTAS67 - Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067
Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest
Shield Line: Riot Police Tactics Demo
The Seventh Day at the Tsubaki House - Whoever You Accuse Is Guilty
Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
Which Sausage, Mate? - 1980: Under the Counter
Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism
games.summary:
Take control of the team led by Saitama Prefecture, joined by allies from across Japan.

Stages are set in carefully selected "hometowns (jimoto)" from Japan's 47 prefectures! Navigate fields filled with familiar landmarks and local specialties!

The game rules are simple: jump and bounce to avoid falling off the stage and reach the goal.

It's a classic side-scrolling platformer. However, your character is completely limp, making even walking a challenge.

The key to the game is mastering its unique controls. Once you get the hang of it, you can even dash and perform big jumps. Give it a try!

games.name: The Lost Pit
games.summary:
Embark on a perilous adventure deep in the heart of a wild forest. Run along ancient trails, cross crocodile-infested lakes, dodge underground scorpions, avoid venomous snakes, and swing across vines with perfectly timed jumps.

Put your reflexes to the test in a journey that demands skill and courage. Every obstacle you overcome brings you one step closer to proving you're a true explorer.

Can you survive the dangers of the jungle, collect the treasures, and complete the expedition before time runs out?

games.name: A Heart-Stirring Date by Victoria Harbour: New Year's Eve at the Turn of the Millennium
How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
War Tiles: Napoleons Invasion of Russia
AURORA REQUIEM: The Lullaby of Calvaris
Cozy Cat Room: Focus Time with Your Cat
Desktop Cozy Cat Tree - Water Park
How To Ride Elevators Like A Human
Jellystar Empires: When Space Bunnies Attack!!
KEEP IT TIDY! Tiny Helpers Demo
Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer Soundtrack
Pizzarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Shop Demo
Reypunk: An Eye For An Eye Demo
Spirit Crossing
games.summary:
Prepare to adventure into a joyful world with Spirit Crossing, a massively cooperative life sim designed to encourage friendship and make the world feel a little less lonely.

From award-winning cozy games studio Spry Fox, journey through an ever-changing landscape as you spread kindness throughout a vibrant, inviting community.

games.name: Stickman Breaks Into the World of Mathematics
The Legend of the Crystal Revolver
Tiny Touches - A Cozy Customization Shop
Duck Side of the Moon
games.summary: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

games.name: Gunboat God
games.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

games.name: Moonlight Peaks
games.summary: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks. Raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids in this heartwarming supernatural life-sim. Eternity awaits!

games.name: POPUCOM
games.summary: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

games.name: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary:
In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem.

You’ll clear blocked paths, collect litter, fix broken signs - and occasionally drop everything to respond to urgent wildlife sightings or missing hikers. Each day brings new tasks and surprises.

Faremont’s diverse biomes range from dense forests and meadows to winding rivers. With your ranger pickup, you’ll cover long distances along the park’s road network, reaching remote areas filled with natural landmarks like waterfalls, rock formations, and scenic viewpoints.

As you explore, use your camera to observe animal behavior and expand your personal wildlife lexicon. From elusive wolves and majestic eagles to mischievous raccoons, each species adds life to the park’s biological habitat.

games.name: Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
games.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. 

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. 

Sounds like vacation to me. 

Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida – forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

games.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
games.summary: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

games.name: Reverie in the Moonlight
games.summary: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?

games.name: Sumikkogurashi Welcome to Poka Poka Onsen
games.summary:
In this game, you will work with the Sumikko characters to help out at a busy hot spring inn that is short-staffed, aiming to make it a popular inn where everyone can gather. You will work hard at various jobs such as guiding guests and cleaning, adding new facilities and making it a wonderful hot spring inn.

Use the coins that guests earn by using the facilities to open shops, game corners, and more to develop the inn. The more facilities you add and the higher your level, the more coins you earn, and the more facilities you can open! You can enjoy the excitement of expanding your possibilities and the sense of accomplishment as your inn becomes more lively.

This game offers endless fun and replayability. In this game, you'll experience the satisfaction of gradually expanding a quiet hot spring inn into a vibrant place, while enjoying a relaxing hot spring life with the comical and adorable Sumikko characters.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online
games.summary:
For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online.

Key Features

    Full online cooperative play for up to four players, on console.
    The complete game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth plus all downloadable content (“Afterbirth,” “Afterbirth+,” “Repentance,” and “Repentance+”).
    Hundreds of items, dozens of characters and endlessly randomized runs.
    Rebalanced items and improvements from years of updates.

games.name: Time Machine : Hidden Objects
games.summary:
Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure through space and time! 

Herbert Fink, a young scientist, faces difficult yet fascinating challenges. An ordinary trip out of town turns into a real investigation, full of intrigue and mysterious temporal anomalies!

Colorful scenery, animation, and 3D visual effects will make your adventure vivid and fun. Those with a competitive streak can collect bonuses for speed and repeat the quest with new puzzles

games.name: Tanks Sweet Tanks
games.summary:
It’s fast. It’s fun. It’s addicting. 

Deafest the enemy tanks while dodging their deadly bullets. 
Improve your aim and maneuver skill while war itself is trying to end your adventure. 
Level by level the enemy's tanks get faster, smarter, and deadlier. 
Can you make it to the end and defeat their leader? 

Play alone. Play with your friends. Play against your friends. 

- Play the single-player campaign to practice your skills and beat the game by yourself. 
- Finish the campaign with 2 players in the co-op mode. 
- Defeat your friends in the VS Mode for up to 4 players.

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: The Spotter: Dig or Die
games.summary: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

games.name: Gothic 3
games.summary: You have saved the island Khorinis from the forces of evil in Gothic I and Gothic II. Now it is time to travel to the realms of the mainland. Invading Orcs have enslaved the human kingdom. There are but a few free humans in the icy north and the southern desert and a handful of rebels hiding in the forests and mountains of Midland. You may either join the rebellion or serve the Orcish Usurpers but you will ultimately tip the scales and decide the outcome of the last war to save humanity. There is no simple linear story in Gothic III - every game will be different and unique - but all will ultimately lead to you deciding the fate of Myrtana.

games.name: Storage Hunter Simulator
games.summary:
Step up to the challenge and take a risk in the world of Storage Hunter Simulator, where you'll compete against others for the ultimate prize - garages filled with hidden treasures waiting to be discovered! In this exciting game, you'll have the chance to showcase your skills and become a giant of the storage market!

In this simulation game, you'll need to master the art of auctions, selling valuable items to wealthy collectors, and improving your skills as an appraiser to stay ahead of the competition. But that's just the beginning - the storage empire is waiting for you!

games.name: Sunstone of Time
games.summary:
Step into the role of a brilliant young scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secret discovery, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs, and your only hope of returning home!

After a groundbreaking experiment goes awry, you awaken in a distant past, thrust into an unfamiliar era. Explore breathtaking temples, ancient settlements, and sacred sites. Piece together forgotten knowledge, interact with a vibrant world, and meet unique characters, each with their own stories and motives. But danger lurks in the shadows: a powerful high priest is weaving dark schemes that threaten not only your fate, but the future of the entire world. Only your intelligence, courage, and insatiable curiosity can guide you through this ancient labyrinth of challenges.

Unravel a rich and engaging story as every step brings you closer to understanding Aztec culture and uncovering the path back to your own time. Will you rise to the challenge, reshape your destiny, and save the world?

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: GRIME II
games.summary:
Become a stealer of forms in GRIME II, the sequel to 2021's acclaimed action-adventure Metroidvania. You are a Formless - an art mimic, absorbing creatures and summoning molds in their shape.

Venture into a new and mysterious land in the GRIME universe, where danger and wonder await around every corner. Use your surroundings in tandem with your summoned molds to overcome deadly enemies and epic bosses, all the while exploring a deep world full of diverse cultures and characters.

Create your own playstyle by choosing from a variety of abilities, weapons, and mold summons. Learn the makings of your enemies as you summon their form to both aid you in combat, as well as in exploring the various secrets paths of the world.

games.name: MR. ELEVATOR
games.summary: Hello, I'm Mr. Elevator. Are you seeking a bizarre puzzle game? If you want a game where five people in an elevator explore a strange world drawn like early Windows Paint, listening to odd symbols and sounds to solve mysteries and descend to the deep floors, this is it.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary:
The city is lost. From the castle at its center an evil spreads, changing everyone into wretched parodies of life. Desolate streets infested with monsters, perpetually dark skies threaten to spread across the land.

Be the hero, reach the GrimKeep and end the source of evil; the Princess.

In a world of fairy tales turned nightmares, GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder that challenges you to master both luck and strategy. Collect powerful relics, forge unstoppable synergies, and battle through a city consumed by darkness.

games.name: Silly Polly Beast
games.summary: An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

games.name: Treachery in Beatdown City: Ultra Remix
games.summary: Treachery in Beatdown City: ULTRA REMIX is a massive story and content update for Treachery in Beatdown City! Tripling the content, Ultra Remix adds new levels, lots of new exciting attacks, defense options, ~80 more enemies to fight, new music, and more!

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Dune: Awakening - Blood and Ice
games.summary:
The Polar Sink map features two distinct biomes: the tundra and the ice cap. Players begin in the tundra, where wealthy water shipper families defend their lavish strongholds. Beyond lies the heavily guarded ice cap, where securing access to ice becomes a central goal.

Equipment built for the desert heat will need upgrading to withstand the cold. With the action returning to the ground, traversal, temperature management, and combat become essential to progression. Resources found only in the Polar Sink will allow players to craft the gear they need to survive.

The new map offers around 35 hours of progression, with opportunities to return for valuable resources. Harvested ice can cool base equipment and speed up production, while the free expansion also introduces new vehicle modules, augments, and specialization traits. Future updates will add further reasons to revisit the region.

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

games.name: Plinko Plonko Plunko
games.summary:
Plinko Plonko Plunko is a collection of ball-based arcade games inspired by classic video games. Collide colored balls at the targets to earn Lips that open entry to coolest game of all - Ballceteria.

The aim of Plinko Plonko Plunko is to build up your collection of colored balls that you get to bliss out with in Ballceteria. Shoot, grab, dodge, and pray your way in the games to increase the number of balls in your collection.

Plinko Plonko Plunko is unapologetically bonkers, unbelievably British, and unashamedly tacky. Sometimes if you want something to exist you have to make it yourself.

games.name: Luma Island
games.summary:
Travel to Luma Island to go on an epic adventure by yourself or with your friends and family. 

Begin your extraordinary journey in a humble old caravan and rise to the grand achievement of building a majestic manor that you can proudly call your home.

Traverse the island solving quests and helping the locals through their struggles. Dangerous spider caves, ancient temples, mind-bending puzzles and hidden treasures await you!

Pick from seven unique in-depth professions each with its own progression path. Upgrade your tools to gather rare materials and collaborate with your teammates to become the masters of your crafts.

games.name: The Ascent: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. 

You play as a worker enslaved by The Ascent Group, a corporate-run metropolis stretching high into the sky and filled with creatures from all over the galaxy. You must take up arms and embark on a new mission to find out what started it all.

games.name: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster
games.summary:
Take flight in this remastered 'stick control era' aerial combat RPG. Explore haunting landscapes, engage in epic dogfights, and uncover ancient secrets in a visually enhanced, rebalanced edition of the BAFTA-nominated, award-winning original.

You take on the role of Falconeer, a powerful airborne warrior traversing a vast oceanic world torn apart by generations of poisonous decisions and dissent. Throughout multiple campaigns, you will experience life from many different perspectives and loyalties as you embark on a journey of discovery, and solve the mystery of the Ursee, its people and history.

Progress through perilous missions and side quests, wielding your lightning caster to protect ships against pirates, kraken and other threats. Dive through the deep ocean depths, soar above the clouds to do battle with giant crab cities or engage in furious dogfights against the mysterious Mancer Order that controls and regulates technology.

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. Framed for murdering the Emperor, villainess Scarlet and Lily, fight the Empire as the first Streamers in history. Capture every enemy and turn them into allies for a happy ending... Or execute everyone and become the Demon Queen!

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2: Side Effects Guaranteed
Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: Bloodrush: Undying Wish
games.summary:
Dash, shoot and strike in this lightning-paced hack n' slash roguelike set in a gothic, undying world!

Focused on movement abilities, split-second decision-making and stylish strings of attacks, Bloodrush encourages a creative approach to combat, combining abilities to demolish your foes!

Delve into Death's domain in multiple runs, unlocking the Stranger's vast arsenal of 6 weapons, 10+ combos, 20+ upgrades, and more.

Uncover insights into Death's imprisonment, progressively learning more of her captors' motivations and philosophies at every run.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: E.S.D.E.
games.summary:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction. Most of the population has disappeared, and those who remain have transformed into strange, soulless anomalies creatures that were once human and have now become a terrifying, unknown threat.

Every expedition is a gamble.
One mistake could be your last.

In E.S.D.E., every expedition is a high-stakes gamble. Explore six different zones, from massive apartment complexes to an old school, and recover valuable items that you can sell to merchants to fund your next runs. Face seven types of anomalies, each with unique behaviors.
 
Every expedition puts you at risk, so stay alert. If something is lurking nearby, put on your mask quickly and make sure it doesn't spot you. You'll be on your own for most of your time in these dangerous zones.

Every threat looks different.
Learn to recognize them before it's too late.

Explore six distinct zones, recover valuable items,
and live to tell the tale.

Wearing your mask could be crucial to keeping certain anomalies from detecting you.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary:
The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples - so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination - now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

But saving a world already doomed is no easy task. With the help of Ysoris, her unlikely mentor, and Kanta, shaman prince of a lost tribe, Eline must overcome the formidable adversaries standing in her way.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.summary: Hello! Bouncy Bernard is a cute doggy that likes fun a lot. Puzzles is one of his favorite. However, this is not only about fun. He is very smart and is fond of discovering the world as well. He invites you to accompany him in doing this. Today he wants to be with you to discover striking representations of well-known racing cars and vehicles. There are Formula 1 car, motorcycles, NASCAR racing cars, rally cars, monster trucks, snowmobiles and water scooters. So, as you can see there is huge collection of objects to became familiar with and have fun in playing puzzles along with Bouncy Bernard. Don’t wait any longer! Main features: - Interactive puzzles parts for children aged 3+. - Three levels of difficulty (6 parts, 12 parts, 20 parts puzzles). - Beautiful and realistic 3D pictures that are created to both entertain and educate children. - Intuitive navigation. - Drag and drop puzzle pieces. Tap a piece to make it large, move into the place of destination and release. - Gray, faded picture background facilitating matching pieces. - Supporting sound effects. - Switch on / off music function.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

games.name: FreeStyle Football 2
games.summary:
In FreeStyle Football 2, each of the 12 characters available at launch will feature unique skills that dramatically shape playstyles, whether it’s delivering lightning-fast passes, boosting teammates’ morale, or unleashing a power shot at the perfect moment. Every match is about teamwork, precise coordination, and tactical depth, with players controlling one character each in intense five-versus-five online battles.

The game will be available in multiple editions, including Basic, Premium, Deluxe, and Limited Club Edition, with monetization through a familiar console framework of Season Passes, downloadable content, and ongoing content updates.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Pets
games.summary:
Welcome to Puffin Isle! This slightly neglected region of Pinnacove seems in urgent need of a makeover. From charming villas to forgotten landmarks, these jobs are sure to surprise you! 

Meeting friends old and new, can you help them make this place a cozy haven for all animal lovers? Or will you focus on creating your own pet-centered houses for other players to enjoy?

Learn more about different breeds and species, observe them, and fulfill their needs to see them thrive. Let one of your cats or dogs accompany you during renovations and watch your friends pet them together in the co-op mode. Relax after a day of hard work by playing with your little companions and forge a bond that will last a lifetime.

games.name: Million Depth
games.summary: Craft original weapons and engage in strategic time-freezing battles as you dive into the million-floor deep underground world of this deep-diving action strategy game.

games.name: PowerWash Simulator 2: Barbie Pack
games.summary:
With Barbie, You Can Be Anything! 

Turns out, “anything” includes a PowerWasher Barbie. Step outside of the box and power wash your way through Malibu in this clean-up adventure spanning five levels. Spray away muck, revealing sparkling, pristine plastic beneath!

Show dirt who’s boss in a sleek new look that takes power dressing to a whole new level. Accessorize with a range of practical and chic tools and attachments that make cleaning up a dream. Trade in the pink convertible and take your new abseiling kit and scissor lift for a spin to help hunt dirt high and low.

Ever wanted to ride the DreamHouse elevator from the point of view of Barbie? Or chill by the fire in front of the Dream Camper? Now you can. Escape to the ideal destination where the only pressure is in the water, as you blast away dirt from five new levels teeming with Barbie playsets and accessories.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary:
Thirteen months after six young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the nightmare. 

When a mysterious recording rekindles the hope that her daughter might still be alive, Susan, against all reason, decides to go to the place where everything seems to have begun: a decaying noble residence isolated on the slopes of Mount Etna and once owned by the Ashmann family.

What starts as a desperate search soon becomes a journey into terror, where family secrets, memory, and obsession intertwine. Susan finds herself drawn into a labyrinth of relentless stalkers, hidden symbols, and supernatural phenomena. As reality fractures and dark powers rise, every step brings her closer to the truth… and to a terror older than herself.

Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy blends classic survival horror, stealth, and psychological horror, introducing new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis, and environmental manipulation.

games.name: SOMBRAS: negative frames
games.summary:
Shiomi Alterio, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, lives with her father in a quaint Japanese town after her parents’ recent divorce, far from the life in Europe she was forced to leave behind.

One night, Shiomi is engulfed by a dark dimension made of familiar streets, hungry shadows, and a cast of girls that look just like her...

Help Shiomi return home by taking pictures of unusual sights, surviving unsettling encounters, and reuniting every single fragment of her broken self.

games.name: STEP THEATER
games.summary:
An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life.

Step Theater is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, Step Theater gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.

Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.

games.name: The Dark Queen of Mortholme
games.summary:
Experience a macabre, short-form, second-person indie, you play as The Dark Queen of Mortholme, the final barrier between the Hero and the end credits. 

In this fixed-screen pixel art game, use the Queen's attacks against this hero, slay them, and quell this nuisance once and for all. 

But, wait. How is this possible? The Hero keeps coming back. 

Depending on your dialogue choices, the story will play out differently. Will you see the Hero's point of view, or continue ruling as the Queen Everlasting?

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary:
Dive into a story-driven survival-horror adventure inspired by classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill. 

A miracle crop designed to end famine became humanity’s ruin. It twisted people into feral creatures called Dusters, hollowed out by a chemical addiction and driven by primal hunger. 

Katherine and her daughter Ava roam the remnants of civilization, searching for a safe haven. But their journey draws the attention of the Pastor and his mysterious following. He sees remaining humans not as people, but as fertile soil for his plans.

Claw your way through decaying streets, bloodthirsty monsters, locked rooms, and forgotten corridors. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and survive encounters with feral Dusters for a chance to reach safety. Proceed with caution: every door can lead to salvation… or devastation.

Protect Ava at all costs. The world can die, but she must live. Every step draws you deeper into a hostile wilderness that wants you gone. No one is coming to save you, but you can fight. You can run. You can try to get her to safety.

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.summary:
Play as Garrett, an orphan rescued from the streets by the Keepers—a secretive, ancient order dedicated to maintaining balance in the world - and trained to become a Master Thief. Using minimal weapons and maximum stealth, you must keep to the shadows and move quietly to complete missions and collect treasure without too many casualties. 

In Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, Nightdive Studios brings back the pioneering 3D stealth game from Looking Glass Studios. Described by its developers as a “first-person sneaker,” the 1998 title challenged norms with its non-confrontational gameplay at a time when most first-person games prioritized combat. 

Remastered with Nightdive’s KEX Engine, the release includes Thief: The Dark Project and the additional missions, content and updates from the 1999 Thief Gold re-release. Explore unscripted, maze-like levels with advanced NPCs, who can hear, speak, and sound alarms if you make a wrong move. Each mission includes 3 difficulty settings with different objectives for maximum replayability.

games.name: Waltz and Jam
games.summary: Waltz and Jam is an action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3
games.summary:
"Fighting to liveand living to fight" - A brand new RPG adventure awaits in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. Bringing together the futures of Xenoblade Chronicles and Xenoblade Chronicles 2, this title will take players to the world of Aionios, home to two hostile nations.  Keves: a nation where mechanical technology was developed. Their armies are composed of units consisting mainly of combat vehicles. They use units of small, mobile weapons operated by soldiers riding them. 

Agnus: a nation strong in ether, a magical technology. Their forces are built around units that specialise in ether combat, and they fight with small, mobile, autonomous weapons that use ether technology. 

Six soldiers hailing from these nations, will take part in a grand tale with life as its central theme. 

Noah: One of the protagonists of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 and a solider of Keves. Noah is also an "off-seer" who mourns for soldiers who've lost their lives on the battlefield. 

Lanz: An ally of Noah's who wields a great sword that doubles as a shield. 

Eunie: A childhood friend of Noah and Lanz who has a sharp tongue and rough personality. She specialises in healing her allies in battle. 

Mio: The other protagonist of this story, Mio is a soldier of Agnus and an off-seer like Noah.
